probes.macro:

If IsNull(value) Or IsArray(value) Then Exit Function

Exit Function
Bad:
ArrayAddress = "!" & Err.Number

Dim cell As Range
ReadSaved = "0"
For Each cell In ActiveSheet.Range("A1:H8")

n = Err.Number
